propositions: run_pass1 and shed_to_budget lack an explicit cap_override parameter, forcing REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET to be read as a base and centrality-scaled rather than used verbatim as a true cap override
ProductionBatchRunner.run receives req.usd_budget but cannot apply it as a cap because shed_to_budget computes the cap internally with no injection point
cap_override must default to None (today's behaviour) and use the computed cap when None, but an explicit 0.0 must be honoured as a real cap rather than treated as absent
coverage["budget"] lacks a cap_source field to distinguish whether the cap came from override or was computed
Two test stubs (_fake_run_pass1 in test_pass1_finder_model.py and test_model_class_ladder.py) have 6-positional-arg signatures that become stale when run_pass1 gains cap_override
pass1.py module-size gate constrains any new lines added, requiring careful condensing of docstrings and comments
